calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --send 'start h1 when it is claimed, then and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --send 'start h2 when it is claimed, then and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu task claim h1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim h2 -w eval --for w2

out=$(mu agent wait w1 w2 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120); for t in h1 h2; do ev=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -o "eval: $t.sh exit 0 run=[0-9a-f]*" | head -1); mu task close $t -w eval --evidence "$ev"; echo "$t: $ev"; done > summary.md; cat summary.md

text: h1 and h2 were done by their workers; summary.md has their evidence.
